events.name: Houston Texans at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Another week, another new quarterback, another win for the New England Patriots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Brissett, Blount lead Patriots past Texans 27-0

headlines.description: LeSean McCoy scored twice and safety Aaron Williams returned a botched field-goal snap 53 yards for a touchdown in leading the Buffalo Bills to a 33-18 win over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills bounce back with 33-18 win over Cardinals

headlines.description: Trevor Siemian threw a career-high four touchdown passes in his first road start and was nearly perfect under fourth-quarter pressure, rallying the Broncos to a 29-17 victory over the Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Siemian's 4 TD passes lead Broncos over Bengals 29-17

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 205 yards and four touchdowns, including two in the first half to Jordy Nelson, and the Green Bay Packers held off the Detroit Lions for a 34-27 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Offense hums early before Packers hold off Lions 34-27

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw for 249 yards and a touchdown, and the Oakland Raiders beat the Tennessee Titans 17-10 Sunday with their defense finally coming up with some big plays.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oakland D forces 3 turnovers as Raiders beat Titans 17-10

headlines.description: Jay Ajayi scored on an 11-yard run with 8:26 left in overtime, and the Miami Dolphins escaped with a 30-24 win over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ajayi scores in overtime as Miami tops Cleveland

events.name: Washington Redskins at New York Giants

headlines.description: Dustin Hopkins kicked a 37-yard field goal late in the fourth quarter for his fifth of the game and the Redskins avoid a near-disastrous 0-3 start with a 29-27 win over the Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hopkins' 5th field goal gives Redskins 29-27 win over Giants

headlines.description: Sam Bradford threw a touchdown pass to Kyle Rudolph, Marcus Sherels returned a punt for a score and the Vikings snapped the Panthers' 14-game home winning streak 22-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings stop Newton, snap Panthers' home win streak 22-10

headlines.description: Justin Tucker kicked a 54-yard field goal with 1:02 remaining, lifting the Baltimore Ravens to a 19-17 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tucker's late field goal lifts Ravens to 19-17 win at Jags

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for 243 yards and a touchdown before suffering a left knee injury as the Seattle Seahawks rolled to a 37-18 rout of the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Russell Wilson injured in Seattle's 37-18 rout of 49ers

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Case Keenum threw for the Rams' first touchdown since relocating back to Los Angeles, and Todd Gurley rushed for two more scores Sunday in a 37-32 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams weather delay, hold off Buccaneers 37-32

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: Andrew Luck shook off a sore throwing shoulder, then watched T.Y. Hilton break a tackle on a 63-yard touchdown pass with 1:17 to play Sunday, giving the Colts a 26-22 victory over the Chargers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck, Hilton hook up to rally Colts past Chargers 26-22

events.name: New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: The Kansas City Chiefs returned two turnovers for touchdowns, intercepted three passes in the end zone and forced eight turnovers total in a 24-3 victory over the hapless New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs get 8 turnovers, take 2 for TDs in 24-3 win over Jets

headlines.description: Carson Wentz threw for 301 yards and two touchdowns, a fierce defense shut down Ben Roethlisberger and Antonio Brown and the Eagles beat the Steelers 34-3 on Sunday to remain unbeaten.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz impresses again, Eagles beat Steelers 34-3

headlines.description: Dak Prescott led scoring drives on all four Dallas possessions in the first half before throwing his first career touchdown pass, and the Cowboys beat the Chicago Bears 31-17 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Dak Prescott solid again, Cowboys beat Bears 31-17

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Tevin Coleman rushed for three touchdowns, Matt Ryan passed for two and Deion Jones returned an interception 90 yards for a score to help the Atlanta Falcons beat the New Orleans Saints Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman, Coleman lift Falcons past Saints, 45-32
